about: Door rows code that read and rewrote the shipped tools/connect-a-service-and-seal-its-key/records.json. Each was already ported one to one (ports/move-public-door.json, REF-PUBLIC-DOOR-MOVE) into a file here that reads and writes the person's Service connections list through the records door; the shipped copies leave with the door rows, and commit is the last one that has them.
